name: reference_digest
description: SHA-256 over the whole reference sample (ADR 0005). Together with model_uri this is the pool's identity: a new sample or a different LLM is a different pool.

name: model_uri
description: LLM weights URI that produced these values. NOT an embedder identity — that is what makes this a sibling of rag_chunks rather than a chunk_kind of it (ADR 0020).

name: column
description: Free-text column the pool belongs to.

name: values
description: Deduped generated values in insertion order. REPEATED (not a JSON blob) so pools stay queryable with UNNEST. NOTE: `values` is a BigQuery RESERVED keyword — always backtick it in SQL.

name: stagnated
description: True when the ladder stopped yielding novel values before reaching target. Recorded so a later worker reads the conclusion instead of re-running the ladder to re-derive it — the single largest waste in the 2026-07-26 1M run.

name: attempts
description: Ladder attempts spent producing this pool (observability; never a fetch key).
